title: Private Equity Value Creation Podcast: Alex Abell of RCP Advisors on Evaluating Lower-Middle Market Managers and Operational Value Creation
summary: Alex Abell, Managing Partner at RCP Advisors, recently joined Shiv Narayanan, CEO of How To SaaS, on the Private Equity Value Creation Podcast to discuss manager selection in the lower-middle market.
body_markdown:
Alex Abell, Managing Partner at RCP Advisors, recently joined Shiv Narayanan, CEO of How To SaaS, on the Private Equity Value Creation Podcast to discuss manager selection in the lower-middle market.


Alex discussed RCP Advisors’ approach to identifying and backing private equity managers in the lower-middle market. He explained how RCP’s proprietary GPScout data and analytics platform combines decades of market intelligence with deal-level benchmarking, helping the team assess what truly differentiates a manager and identify the strategies and capabilities that can drive repeatable success.


[Watch the podcast.](https://www.howtosaas.com/episode-144-Alex-Abell-of-RCP-Advisors)
